Initial release of youtube-research.

- Fetches structured YouTube data (videos, channels, transcripts, comments, playlists, and search) via the Crawlora API.
- No use of yt-dlp, browser automation, or HTML scraping; all data provided as clean JSON.
- Supports extracting metadata, transcripts, comments, videos, and playlists by ID or URL.
- Search YouTube by keyword and retrieve results in normalized JSON.
- Requires a free Crawlora API key; setup instructions included.
